hooks.name: sync-ninja-schemas-to-typescript
hooks.description: Ensures frontend TypeScript types in frontend/src/lib/types.ts stay synced with Django Ninja schemas

action.prompt: A Django Ninja schema file was just modified. Verify that the corresponding TypeScript interfaces in `frontend/src/lib/types.ts` match the updated Pydantic fields, including EvidenceCitation and epistemic_status enums.
